subject.title: bug: publish-plugin page cannot upload plugin folders; auto-changelog overwrites edits; package changelog uses wrong history

question: Should plugin release publishing add an access-gated README-based package changelog preview flow, or remain manual-only for changelogs?
rationale: Current main is manual-only while the open candidate PR adds product-visible auto-preview behavior with authorization and proof blockers, so automation should not choose that UX direction by itself.

options.title: Review access-gated preview
options.body: Require the linked PR to gate package history reads, add real browser proof, and land it if maintainers want auto-preview on plugin release publishes.

options.title: Keep manual-only release notes
options.body: Decline the preview direction and document that plugin package changelogs remain publisher-authored text on release publish.

recommendation.title: Review access-gated preview
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR to gate package history reads, add real browser proof, and land it if maintainers want auto-preview on plugin release publishes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent history place this person closest to the package/plugin publish and changelog surfaces.
